verses.text: Ayik toxo ix ek' jun pekti', ix cham winhaj Nahas, sreyal heb' amonita, haxo winh yuninal winh skuchan Hanún ix ochkan reyal.

Ix sna' winhaj rey David chi' to yowalil sch'ox swach'k'olal winh t'a winhaj Hanún chi', yujto sch'oxnak swach'k'olal winh smam winh t'a winh. Yuj chi' ix schekb'at juntzanh schekab' winh t'a winhaj Hanún chi' yik syak'an sniwanil sk'o'ol winh yuj schamel smam chi'. Palta ayik ix k'och heb' chekab' t'a schonhab' heb' amonita chi',

a heb' winh yajal yaj t'a chonhab' chi', ix yal heb' winh t'a winhaj Hanún chi': Mamin rey, ¿tom tzak'och t'a a k'o'ol to niwan yelk'och winh a mam chi' t'a yol sat winhaj rey David chi', yuj chi' ix schekkot juntzanh winak tik winh yik syak' sniwanil a k'o'ol heb'? Ma'ay. Ix chekjikot heb' yuj winh yik tzul yil heb' tas yaj ko chonhab' tik, yik tzul satanel heb', xchi heb' t'a winh.

Yuj chi', ix schekan winhaj Hanún chi' yamjok heb' schekab' winhaj rey David chi', ix joxjiel xil sti' heb' t'a jun pak'anh spak'ul sti', ix poljiel yoktak sti' spichul heb' masanto ix k'eul t'a sti' syo'op heb', ix lajwi chi' ix schekan pax heb' winh.

Ayik ix yab'an winhaj rey David chi' tas ix aj heb', ix chekjib'at schaumal heb' yuj winh, yujto te k'ixwelal ix utaj heb', ix alji t'a heb' to skan heb' t'a Jericó masanto sk'ib'xi xil sti' heb' chi', ichato chi' syal smeltzaj pax ta heb'.

Haxo heb' amonita chi', ix nachajel yuj heb' to chuk ix kan heb' t'a winhaj rey David chi', yuj chi' 20 mil heb' soldado yik Siria t'a yol yik Bet-rehob yet' t'a yol yik Soba ix stup heb'. Ix kotpax mil heb' soldado winh sreyal Maaca yet' 12 mil heb' soldado aj Is-tob.
Haxo ix yab'an jun chi' winhaj rey David chi', ix schekanb'at winhaj Joab winh yet' heb' soldado chi'.
Ix elta heb' amonita chi' t'a sti' schonhab', ix sb'oanoch sb'a heb' t'a owal ta', haxo heb' soldado ix tupji yik skot yak' owal chi', najat ix sb'opaxem sb'a heb' t'a stiel chonhab' chi'.

Ayik ix yilan winhaj Joab chi' to ay jun makan heb' soldado t'a yichanh winh, ay pax junxo makan heb' t'a spatik winh, ix sik'anel heb' soldado winh, haton heb' te jelan t'a owal, yik syak'an owal heb' yet' heb' sirio chi'.
Haxo juntzanhxo heb' soldado, ix yak'och winh t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Abisai winh yuk'tak winh, yik sb'at heb' yak' owal yet' heb' amonita chi'.

Ix yalan winhaj Joab chi' t'a winh yuk'tak chi' icha tik: Tato a heb' sirio chi' wan in yak'an ganar, tzach kot in a kolo'. Tato a heb' amonita chi' wan ach yak'an ganar jun, a inxo ol in b'at ach in kolo'.
Kak' kip, ko tek'b'ej ko b'a yuj ko kolan ko chonhab' a onh schonhab' onh ko Diosal tik. Elokab'k'och tas wach' snib'ej Jehová, xchi winhaj Joab chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winhaj Joab chi' yet' heb' soldado yak' owal yet' heb' sirio chi', haxo ix aji, ix el lemnaj heb' t'a yichanh winh.

Ayik ix yilan heb' amonita to toxo ix el lemnaj heb' sirio chi', ix elpax lemnaj heb' t'a yichanh winhaj Abisai, ix och heb' skol sb'a t'a yol schonhab' chi'. Yuj chi' ix och wa'an winhaj Joab chi' yak'an owal yet' heb' amonita chi', ix meltzajkot winh t'a Jerusalén.
Ayik ix yilan heb' sirio chi' to ix ak'ji ganar heb' yuj heb' israel, ix smolb'anxi sb'a heb'.

Ix awtajkot heb' sirio chi' yuj winhaj rey Hadad-ezer, haton heb' ay t'a junxo sk'axepalek' ha' Éufrates, ix k'och heb' t'a chonhab' Helam. Ha winhaj Sobac b'ab'el t'a yichanh heb', haton winh yajal t'a heb' soldado yik winhaj rey Hadad-ezer chi'.

Palta ix alchajpax juntzanh tik t'a winhaj rey David, yuj chi' ix smolb'ej masanil heb' soldado yik Israel winh, ix ek' heb' t'a sk'axepal ha' Jordán, ix k'och heb' t'a Helam. Hata' ix stek'b'ej sb'a heb' sirio chi' yak'an owal yet' heb' israel chi'.

Haxo ix aji, ix el lemnaj heb' sirio chi' t'a yichanh winhaj rey David chi' yet' heb' israel. 40 mil soldado ayk'e t'a yib'anh chej yet' pax 700 heb' ayoch t'a yol carruaje ix smilcham heb' soldado yik Israel chi'. Ix champax winhaj Sobac yajalil heb' soldado sirio yuj heb'.

Ayik ix yilan masanil heb' rey ayoch yet' winhaj rey Hadad-ezer chi' to toxo ix ak'ji ganar heb' yuj heb' israel chi', ix yak'anoch sb'a heb' t'a junk'olal yet' heb' israel chi', yuj chi' ix kanxonhej heb' t'a yalanh smandar winhaj rey David chi'. Atax ta' ix xiwkank'e heb' sirio chi', majxo yak'xiochlaj sb'a heb' skolwaj yet' heb' amonita chi'.
